llm.summary: MeshMorize is a disclosed memory skill, but it asks to auto-log every interaction without clear user consent, retention, deletion, or sensitive-data controls.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is a multi-layer memory system with daily notes, mesh graph indexing, auto-logging, search, and compliance checks; those capabilities fit the purpose, but they involve broad conversation retention.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md explicitly describes 'auto-log every interaction' and provides an auto_log command, but does not scope what should be logged, when logging starts, or how to avoid secrets and sensitive content.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The submitted artifact contains only SKILL.md, no executable scripts, dependency declarations, install hooks, or hidden setup behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Memory files under memory/fresh and memory/mesh.json are coherent for the feature, but cross-layer search and graph indexing can expose or correlate private user-provided content.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill advertises durable logging and indexed memory, including a 5-day rotation only for the fresh layer, with no clear retention, purge, export, opt-in, or access-control instructions for the broader log and mesh memory.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Review before installing. This skill is not showing hidden code or malware in the submitted files, but it is designed to store and search conversation history. Only use it if you are comfortable with broad memory logging, and avoid using it around passwords, tokens, private business data, or regulated personal information unless you add clear opt-in, redaction, and deletion controls.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The auto-logging behavior is expected for a memory skill and is disclosed, but the artifact does not provide consent, minimization, or sensitive-data handling guidance.
[SSD-3] expected: Persistent searchable memory is purpose-aligned, but blanket retention of interactions is under-scoped and lacks user-facing controls in the submitted artifact.
